def write_record(project: Path, graph, decision_id: int, event: str | None = None) -> Path:
    """Create or update the decision's record; returns its path (also stored on the node)."""
    project = Path(project)
    if event:
        note_history(graph, decision_id, event)
    d = graph.get_node(decision_id)
    path = existing_path(project, d)
    block = "\n".join(summary_block(project, graph, d)) + "\n"
    if path is None:
        path = next_path(project, d)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        title = ("AI model" if d["data"].get("kind") == "model"
                 else (d["data"].get("category") or "Decision").capitalize())
        text = f"# {path.stem[:4]}. {title}: {d['label']}\n\n" + block
    else:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if BEGIN in text and END in text:
            head, rest = text.split(BEGIN, 1)
            text = head + block.rstrip("\n") + rest.split(END, 1)[1]
            text = text.rstrip("\n") + "\n"
        else:
            text = text.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + block
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    graph.update_data(decision_id, decision_record=_rel(path, project))
    return path


def write_records(project: Path, graph, decision_ids, event: str, tracer=None,
                  out=None, entire=None) -> list[Path]:
    """write_record for several decisions, then offer each record to Entire Brain."""
    from notbydefault import brain
    paths = []
    for did in decision_ids:
        path = write_record(project, graph, did, event)
        paths.append(path)
        if tracer is not None:
            tracer.event("decision_record", "state", f"#{did}: {event} -> {_rel(path, project)}",
                         decision_id=did, path=_rel(path, project))
        saved, msg = brain.save(project, path, graph.get_node(did), entire)
        if tracer is not None:
            tracer.event("brain_saved" if saved else "brain_skipped",
                         "state" if saved else "recovery", msg, decision_id=did)
        if out is not None and (saved or did == decision_ids[0]):
            out(msg)
    return paths
PYEOF

next Entire checkpoint. `check` writes a detailed body (results table, case results); this module
keeps a generated summary block at the end of the file (between the markers below) up to date:
status, why, evidence links, rejected alternatives, caveats, affected code and status history.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

BEGIN = "<!-- notbydefault:summary:begin (generated; edits inside are overwritten) -->"
END = "<!-- notbydefault:summary:end -->"
STATUS_TEXT = {"unreviewed": "Unreviewed (detected from an agent tool call; not fit-tested)",
               "reviewed": "Reviewed", "stale": "STALE (provably conflicts with a requirement)",
               "needs_review": "Needs review (may conflict, depending on how it is deployed)",
               "accepted": "Accepted"}


def folder(project: Path) -> Path:
    return Path(project) / "decisions"


def slug(decision: dict) -> str:
    kind = decision["data"].get("kind") or "decision"
    prefix = "ai-model" if kind == "model" else (decision["data"].get("category") or kind)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", f"{prefix}-{decision['label']}".lower()).strip("-")[:60]


def next_path(project: Path, decision: dict) -> Path:
    f = folder(project)
    numbers = [int(m.group(1)) for p in f.glob("*.md") if (m := re.match(r"(\d{4})-", p.name))]
    return f / f"{max(numbers, default=0) + 1:04d}-{slug(decision)}.md"

    rel = decision["data"].get("decision_record")

"""Save decision records to Entire Brain, when the entire-brain plugin is installed.

Brain is not in Entire's plugin index (`entire plugin search brain` finds nothing as of
entire 0.11.4) and its commands are not in the Entire docs, so nothing here guesses a command:
when the plugin is installed we read `entire brain --help`, pick a save-like subcommand only if
the help lists one, read that subcommand's own --help, and pass the record the way that help
documents (a --file flag or a <file>/<path> argument). Otherwise we skip and say why.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from notbydefault.entire import Entire

SAVE_SUBCOMMANDS = ("save", "add", "remember", "ingest", "import")
INSTALL_HINT = (
    "Entire Brain is not installed, so the decision record was not saved to Brain (skipped). "
    "`entire plugin list` doesn't list it and `entire plugin search brain` finds nothing in the "
    "plugin index; if you have access to it, install it with "
    "`entire plugin install <its repository URL, or a local entire-brain executable>` "
    "(https://docs.entire.io/cli-reference/plugin), then run "
    "`python -m notbydefault records --project <dir>` to save existing records.")


def _subcommands(help_text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Names listed under a cobra-style 'Available Commands:' / 'Commands:' section."""
    names, inside = [], False
    for line in help_text.splitlines():
        if re.match(r"\s*(Available )?Commands:\s*$", line):
            inside = True
            continue
        if inside:
            m = re.match(r"\s{2,}([a-z][\w-]*)\s", line + " ")
            if m:
                names.append(m.group(1))
            elif line.strip() == "" and names:
                inside = False
    return names


def save_command(entire: Entire, path: Path) -> list[str] | None:
    """The documented `entire brain ...` invocation that saves `path`, or None."""
    top = entire.run(["brain", "--help"], timeout=20) or ""
    sub = next((s for s in SAVE_SUBCOMMANDS if s in _subcommands(top)), None)
    if sub is None:
        return None
    usage = entire.run(["brain", sub, "--help"], timeout=20) or ""
    if re.search(r"--file\b", usage):
        return ["brain", sub, "--file", str(path)]
    if re.search(rf"brain {sub}\b[^\n]*<(file|path)>", usage, re.I):
        return ["brain", sub, str(path)]
    return None


def save(project: Path, record: Path, decision: dict | None,
         entire: Entire | None = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """(saved?, message for the user). Never raises."""
    entire = entire or Entire()
    try:
        if not entire.has_plugin("brain"):
            return False, INSTALL_HINT
        cmd = save_command(entire, Path(record))
        if cmd is None:
            return False, ("Entire Brain is installed, but its --help documents no subcommand "
                           f"that saves a file (looked for: {', '.join(SAVE_SUBCOMMANDS)}); "
                           "skipped saving the decision record to Brain.")
        if entire.run(cmd, cwd=project, timeout=60) is None:
            return False, f"Saving to Entire Brain failed ({entire.last_error()}); skipped."
        return True, f"Saved {Path(record).name} to Entire Brain (`entire {' '.join(cmd[:2])}`)."
    except Exception as e:      # Brain is optional: never break a verdict over it
        return False, f"Entire Brain unavailable ({e}); skipped."

"""Milestone 4 part 3: decision records on every verdict, and Entire Brain (mocked CLI)."""
from conftest import FakeEntireRunner
from notbydefault import brain
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.records import BEGIN, END, write_record, write_records

PLUGINS_NO_BRAIN = "Managed plugin directory: x\n\n  graph  v0.4.0  x\\entire-graph.exe\n"
PLUGINS_BRAIN = PLUGINS_NO_BRAIN + "  brain  v0.1.0  x\\entire-brain.exe\n"
BRAIN_HELP = """Entire Brain\n\nUsage:\n  entire brain [command]\n\nAvailable Commands:
  save        Save a document to your brain
  query       Ask your brain\n\nFlags:\n  -h, --help\n"""
SAVE_HELP = "Usage:\n  entire brain save --file <path> [flags]\n\nFlags:\n  --file string\n"


def setup(tmp_path):
    g = Graph.for_project(tmp_path)
    did = g.add_node("decision", "MongoDB", {"kind": "service", "category": "database",
                                             "status": "unreviewed", "file": "requirements.txt",
                                             "evidence": "pymongo", "tool_name": "Bash"}, "sess-1")
    alt = g.add_node("alternative", "PostgreSQL", {"reason": "team knows Mongo"})
    g.add_edge(did, alt, "rejects")
    ev = g.add_node("evidence", "Fit test results", {"path": ".notbydefault/results/1.json"})
    g.add_edge(did, ev, "supported_by")
    return g, did


def entire(responses):
    return Entire(exe="entire", runner=FakeEntireRunner(responses))


def test_record_is_created_with_why_evidence_alternatives_caveats(tmp_path):
    g, did = setup(tmp_path)
    path = write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "detected")
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert path.name == "0001-database-mongodb.md"
    for part in ("### Why", "Bash call (pymongo)", "### Evidence", ".notbydefault/results/1.json",
                 "### Rejected alternatives", "`PostgreSQL`: team knows Mongo", "### Caveats",
                 "### Affected code", "requirements.txt", "sess-1", "detected"):
        assert part in text, part
    assert g.get_node(did)["data"]["decision_record"] == "decisions/0001-database-mongodb.md"
    g.close()


def test_record_is_updated_in_place_and_keeps_hand_written_text(tmp_path):
    g, did = setup(tmp_path)
    path = write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "detected")
    path.write_text("# 0001. My notes\n\nHand-written context.\n\n" + path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                    .split("\n\n", 1)[1], encoding="utf-8")
    g.update_data(did, status="needs_review", review_reason="depends on where it runs",
                  review_basis="depends on deployment", review_source="https://docs")
    again = write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "needs review after requirement #9")
    text = again.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert again == path and len(list((tmp_path / "decisions").glob("*.md"))) == 1
    assert "Hand-written context." in text and text.count(BEGIN) == 1 and text.count(END) == 1
    assert "Needs review" in text and "https://docs" in text
    assert "needs review after requirement #9" in text and "detected" in text   # history
    g.close()


def test_check_record_is_reused_for_the_same_decision(tmp_path):
    """A record written by `check` (no markers yet) gets the summary block appended."""
    g, did = setup(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "decisions").mkdir()
    old = tmp_path / "decisions" / "0003-ai-model-x.md"
    old.write_text(f"# 0003. AI model\n\n- Decision graph node: #{did} (`x`)\n\nBody.\n",
                   encoding="utf-8")
    assert write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "fit check") == old
    assert "Body." in old.read_text(encoding="utf-8") and BEGIN in old.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    g.close()


def test_brain_missing_explains_how_to_install_and_skips(tmp_path):
    g, did = setup(tmp_path)
    notes = []
    write_records(tmp_path, g, [did], "detected", out=notes.append,
                  entire=entire({("plugin", "list"): PLUGINS_NO_BRAIN}))
    assert "not installed" in notes[0] and "entire plugin install" in notes[0]
    assert (tmp_path / "decisions" / "0001-database-mongodb.md").exists()   # record still written
    g.close()


def test_brain_installed_saves_with_the_documented_command(tmp_path):
    g, did = setup(tmp_path)
    runner = FakeEntireRunner({("plugin", "list"): PLUGINS_BRAIN, ("brain", "--help"): BRAIN_HELP,
                               ("brain", "save", "--help"): SAVE_HELP, ("brain", "save", "--file"): "ok"})
    notes = []
    write_records(tmp_path, g, [did], "detected", out=notes.append,
                  entire=Entire(exe="entire", runner=runner))
    assert notes and notes[0].startswith("Saved 0001-database-mongodb.md to Entire Brain")
    [save] = [c for c in runner.calls if c[:3] == ["brain", "save", "--file"]]
    assert save[3].endswith("0001-database-mongodb.md")
    g.close()


def test_brain_without_a_documented_save_command_is_skipped(tmp_path):
    e = entire({("plugin", "list"): PLUGINS_BRAIN,
                ("brain", "--help"): "Available Commands:\n  query   Ask\n\n"})
    saved, msg = brain.save(tmp_path, tmp_path / "x.md", None, e)
    assert not saved and "documents no subcommand" in msg


def test_brain_failure_never_raises(tmp_path):
    e = entire({("plugin", "list"): PLUGINS_BRAIN, ("brain", "--help"): BRAIN_HELP,
                ("brain", "save", "--help"): SAVE_HELP, ("brain", "save", "--file"): 3})
    saved, msg = brain.save(tmp_path, tmp_path / "x.md", None, e)
    assert not saved and "failed" in msg

def sdk_users(index) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Known SDK package -> functions calling it, from the graph's external CALLS edges."""
    from notbydefault.detect import KNOWN_SERVICES
    from notbydefault.affected import IMPORT_NAMES, _pkg_match
    pkgs = sorted({IMPORT_NAMES.get(p, p.replace("-", "_")) for p in KNOWN_SERVICES} | set(KNOWN_SERVICES))
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for e in index.calls:
        if not e["to_id"].startswith("external:symbol:"):
            continue
        target = e["to_id"].split("external:symbol:", 1)[1]
        pkg = _pkg_match(target, pkgs)
        sym = index.symbols.get(e["from_id"])
        if pkg and sym:
            where = f"{sym['path']}:{sym['start_line']} {sym['qualified_name']}"
            users = out.setdefault(pkg, [])
            if all(u["where"] != where for u in users):
                users.append({"where": where, "via": f"calls {target}",
                              "loc": f"{sym['path']}:{sym['start_line']}"})
    return out

    from notbydefault.entire import Entire, git, repo_root
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph

    entire = entire or Entire()
    old = load_cache(project)
    cache = {"updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
             "errors": {}}

    def recover(key: str, why: str) -> None:
        cache["errors"][key] = why
        if tracer is not None:
            tracer.event(f"{key}_fallback", "recovery", why)

    index = Index(project, entire)
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        decisions = [d for d in g.nodes("decision")
                     if decision_ids is None or d["id"] in decision_ids]
        for d in decisions:
            record_affected(g, d["id"], analyze(index, d), tracer)
    if index.ok:
        cache["sdk_users"] = sdk_users(index)
    else:
        cache["sdk_users"] = old.get("sdk_users") or {}
        recover("graph", f"entire-graph unavailable ({index.error}); reuse hints use the last "
                         "cached graph, if any")

    root = repo_root(project)
    prefix = ""
    if root is not None and root != project:
        try:
            prefix = project.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/"
        except ValueError:
            prefix = ""
    known = {c["id"]: c for c in old.get("checkpoints") or []}

"""Milestone 4 part 4: the hook's briefing (graph + cached Entire lookups), mocked CLI."""
import json

import pytest

from conftest import FakeEntireRunner, demo_graph_responses, demo_project
from notbydefault import affected as affected_mod
from notbydefault import briefing
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.hooks.pre_tool import handle

CHECKPOINTS = json.dumps([
    {"checkpoint_id": "01AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", "session_id": "sess-old",
     "date": "2026-10-10T12:00:00+05:30", "message": "Summaries on gpt-oss-120b via Groq",
     "session_ids": ["sess-old"]},
    {"checkpoint_id": "01BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB", "session_id": "sess-x",
     "message": "Unrelated docs tweak"}])
EXPLAIN_A = json.dumps({"checkpoint_id": "01AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA",
                        "files_touched": ["app.py", "README.md"]})
EXPLAIN_B = json.dumps({"checkpoint_id": "01BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB", "files_touched": ["README.md"]})


def responses(search=1):
    r = demo_graph_responses()
    r.update({("checkpoint", "list"): CHECKPOINTS,
              ("checkpoint", "explain", "01AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"): EXPLAIN_A,
              ("checkpoint", "explain", "01BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB"): EXPLAIN_B,
              ("search",): search})
    return r


@pytest.fixture
def project(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(affected_mod, "repo_root", lambda p: tmp_path)
    demo_project(tmp_path)
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        old = g.add_node("decision", "openai/gpt-oss-120b", {
            "kind": "model", "category": "ai-model", "status": "reviewed",
            "verdict_summary": "Keep gpt-oss-120b: passes every check at $1.51/month.",
            "decision_record": "decisions/0001-ai-model-openai-gpt-oss-120b.md",
            "file": "app.py", "files": ["app.py"]})
        alt = g.add_node("alternative", "groq:openai/gpt-oss-20b",
                         {"reason": "invents facts in 3 of 8 outputs"})
        g.add_edge(old, alt, "rejects")
        g.add_node("decision", "OpenAI", {"kind": "service", "category": "ai-provider",
                                          "status": "unreviewed", "evidence": "openai",
                                          "file": "requirements.txt"})
    return tmp_path


def refresh(project, search=1):
    runner = FakeEntireRunner(responses(search))
    return briefing.refresh_cache(project, entire=Entire(exe="entire", runner=runner)), runner


def test_refresh_cache_collects_checkpoints_and_sdk_users_and_degrades_search(project):
    cache, runner = refresh(project)
    assert [c["files"] for c in cache["checkpoints"]] == [["app.py", "README.md"], ["README.md"]]
    users = {u["where"] for u in cache["sdk_users"]["openai"]}
    assert "actions.py:28 extract_action_items" in users
    assert "search" in cache["errors"] and "local checkpoints" in cache["errors"]["search"]
    # checkpoints are immutable: a second refresh doesn't explain them again
    _, runner2 = refresh(project)
    assert not [c for c in runner2.calls if c[:2] == ["checkpoint", "explain"]]


def test_search_hits_are_used_when_entire_search_works(project):
    hits = json.dumps([{"id": "01CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC", "type": "checkpoint",
                        "title": "Chose gpt-oss-120b for summaries"}])
    refresh(project, search=hits)
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        d = g.add_node("decision", "openai/gpt-oss-120b", {"kind": "model", "category": "ai-model",
                                                           "status": "unreviewed", "file": "actions.py"})
        lines = briefing.build(project, g, g.get_node(d), limit=None)
    assert any("[entire search 01CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC]" in l for l in lines)


def test_briefing_has_each_kind_with_a_source_id(project):
    refresh(project)
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        new = g.add_node("decision", "gpt-oss-20b", {"kind": "model", "category": "ai-model",
                                                      "status": "unreviewed", "file": "app.py",
                                                      "files": ["app.py"]})
        lines = briefing.build(project, g, g.get_node(new))
    assert len(lines) == 4
    past, rejected, hist, reuse = lines
    assert past.startswith("Past decision #1 openai/gpt-oss-120b") and "[decision #1, decisions/0001" in past
    assert rejected.startswith("Rejected before: `groq:openai/gpt-oss-20b`") and "[alternative #" in rejected
    assert "[checkpoint 01AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA, session sess-old]" in hist
    assert reuse.startswith("Reuse: ") and "[entire-graph " in reuse


def test_hook_shows_at_most_four_lines_from_cache_only(project, monkeypatch):
    refresh(project)
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr("subprocess.run", lambda *a, **k: calls.append(a) or (_ for _ in ()).throw(
        AssertionError("hook must not run subprocesses")))
    (project / "summary.py").write_text("")
    ev = {"session_id": "s", "tool_name": "Write", "cwd": str(project),
          "tool_input": {"file_path": str(project / "summary.py"),
                         "content": 'MODEL = "openai/gpt-oss-120b"\n'}}
    out = handle(ev, project)
    reason = out["hookSpecificOutput"]["permissionDecisionReason"]
    head, brief = reason.split("\nBriefing (full version in `check`):\n")
    lines = brief.splitlines()
    assert 1 <= len(lines) <= 4 and all(l.startswith("- ") and l.endswith("]") for l in lines)
    assert calls == []


def test_hook_without_cache_still_briefs_from_the_graph(project):
    (project / "summary.py").write_text("")
    ev = {"session_id": "s", "tool_name": "Write", "cwd": str(project),
          "tool_input": {"file_path": str(project / "summary.py"),
                         "content": 'MODEL = "openai/gpt-oss-120b"\n'}}
    reason = handle(ev, project)["hookSpecificOutput"]["permissionDecisionReason"]
    assert "Past decision #1" in reason


def test_hook_journal_tags_focus_areas(project):
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import FOCUS_AREAS, Tracer
    t = Tracer()
    ev = {"session_id": "s", "tool_name": "Bash", "cwd": str(project),
          "tool_input": {"command": "pip install pymongo"}}
    handle(ev, project, tracer=t)
    steps = [e for e in t.journal if e["kind"] == "step"]
    assert [s["name"] for s in steps] == ["detect", "record", "briefing"]
    assert all(e["focus_area"] in FOCUS_AREAS for e in t.journal)

"""`notbydefault why "<question>"`: answer from what was recorded, with citations.

1. retrieve numbered facts, each with a source id:
   - Decision Graph: decisions matching the question, their recorded reason, decision record,
     evidence, rejected alternatives and requirements that made them stale / need review
   - Entire: `entire search` over checkpoints/sessions/commits (needs login + a mirrored repo);
     otherwise local checkpoints (`entire checkpoint list` / `explain`) and `git log`
   - Entire Graph: the code locations each matched decision affects
2. answer: a Groq model may phrase the answer, but only from those facts, citing their ids; an
   answer citing anything else is discarded for the plain fact list. No matching decision with
   a recorded reason -> "no recorded reason". History is never invented.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

STOP = set("""a an the is are was were be been why did do does we our us i you it its this that
these those to of for in on at by with from and or not no what which who how when where use
used using pick picked choose chose chosen decide decided decision instead over than""".split())
NO_REASON = "no recorded reason"


def words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    toks = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*", (text or "").lower())
    return [t.strip("._/-") for t in toks if t not in STOP and len(t.strip("._/-")) >= 2]


def _score(qwords: list[str], text: str) -> int:
    low = (text or "").lower()
    return sum(1 for w in qwords if re.search(rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(w)}", low))


class Facts:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items: list[dict] = []

    def add(self, text: str, source: str, kind: str) -> str:
        fid = f"F{len(self.items) + 1}"
        self.items.append({"id": fid, "text": text, "source": source, "kind": kind})
        return fid

    def ids(self) -> set[str]:
        return {f["id"] for f in self.items}

def match_decisions(graph, question: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Decisions the question is about (label words weigh most), best first."""
    from notbydefault.records import why_text
    q = words(question)
    scored = []
    for d in graph.nodes("decision"):
        label_hits = _score(q, d["label"]) + _score(q, d["label"].split("/")[-1])
        other = _score(q, f"{d['data'].get('category')} {d['data'].get('kind')} {why_text(d)}")
        alts = sum(_score(q, a["label"]) for a in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("rejects",)))
        score = 3 * label_hits + other + 2 * alts
        if label_hits or alts:
            scored.append((score, d["id"], d))
    return [d for _s, _i, d in sorted(scored, key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1]))]


def graph_facts(graph, decisions: list[dict], facts: Facts) -> dict[int, bool]:
    """Facts per decision; returns {decision id: has a recorded reason}."""
    from notbydefault.affected import describe
    from notbydefault.graph import affected_entries
    reasons = {}
    for d in decisions:
        data = d["data"]
        src = f"decision #{d['id']}" + (f", {data['decision_record']}" if data.get("decision_record") else "")
        recorded = data.get("verdict_summary") or data.get("stale_reason") or data.get("review_reason")
        reasons[d["id"]] = bool(recorded)
        status = data.get("status")
        if data.get("verdict_summary"):
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` ({status}): fit-test verdict: "
                      f"{data['verdict_summary']}", src, "reason")
        if status == "stale":
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` is STALE: {data.get('stale_reason')}",
                      src + (f", requirement #{data['stale_cause']}" if data.get("stale_cause") else ""),
                      "reason")
        if status == "needs_review":
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` needs review: {data.get('review_reason')}",
                      src + (f", requirement #{data['review_cause']}" if data.get("review_cause") else ""),
                      "reason")
        if not recorded:
            how = f" ({data['evidence']})" if data.get("evidence") else ""
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` was picked by a coding agent's "
                      f"{data.get('tool_name') or 'tool'} call{how}; {NO_REASON} beyond that",
                      src + (f", session {d['session_id']}" if d.get("session_id") else ""),
                      "no_reason")
        for a in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("rejects",)):
            facts.add(f"Rejected alternative `{a['label']}`: {a['data'].get('reason') or NO_REASON}",
                      f"alternative #{a['id']}", "alternative")
        for e in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("supported_by",)):
            link = e["data"].get("path") or e["data"].get("url")
            facts.add(f"Evidence: {e['label']}", f"evidence #{e['id']}" + (f", {link}" if link else ""),
                      "evidence")
        code = [e for e in affected_entries(d) if e.get("symbol")][:6] or affected_entries(d)[:3]
        if code:
            facts.add(f"Code using `{d['label']}`: " + "; ".join(f"{describe(e)} ({e.get('via')})"
                                                                for e in code),
                      f"{data.get('affected_source') or 'touched files'}: "
                      + ", ".join(f"{e['path']}:{e['line']}" if e.get("line") else e["path"]
                                  for e in code), "code")
    return reasons


def history_facts(project: Path, question: str, decisions: list[dict], facts: Facts,
                  entire, tracer=None) -> str:
    """Entire search hits, or local checkpoints + git log; returns how history was searched."""
    from notbydefault.briefing import load_cache
    from notbydefault.entire import git
    q = words(question) + [w for d in decisions[:2] for w in words(d["label"])]
    hits = entire.search(question, project, limit=5)
    if hits is not None:
        for h in hits:
            if h.get("id"):
                facts.add(f"Entire {h.get('type', 'result')}: {h.get('title') or h.get('snippet')}",
                          f"entire {h.get('type', 'result')} {h['id']}", "history")
        return "entire search"
    why = entire.last_error()
    if tracer is not None:
        tracer.event("search_fallback", "recovery",
                     f"`entire search` unavailable ({why}); searching local checkpoints and git log")
    cps = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if cps is None:
        cps = [{"checkpoint_id": c["id"], "message": c.get("message"), "session_ids": c.get("sessions")}
               for c in load_cache(project).get("checkpoints") or []]
    for c in cps:
        if c.get("checkpoint_id") and _score(q, c.get("message", "")):
            sess = (c.get("session_ids") or [c.get("session_id")])[0]
            facts.add(f"Checkpoint: {c.get('message')}",
                      f"checkpoint {c['checkpoint_id']}" + (f", session {sess}" if sess else ""),
                      "history")
    log = git(["log", "-n", "300", "--format=%H%x09%s", "--", "."], project) or ""
    for line in log.splitlines():
        sha, _, subject = line.partition("\t")
        if subject and _score(q, subject) >= max(1, min(2, len(q))):
            facts.add(f"Commit: {subject}", f"commit {sha}", "history")
    return f"local checkpoints and git log (entire search unavailable: {why})"

"""`notbydefault why "<question>"`: answer from what was recorded, with citations.

1. retrieve numbered facts, each with a source id:
   - Decision Graph: decisions matching the question, their recorded reason, decision record,
     evidence, rejected alternatives and requirements that made them stale / need review
   - Entire: `entire search` over checkpoints/sessions/commits (needs login + a mirrored repo);
     otherwise local checkpoints (`entire checkpoint list` / `explain`) and `git log`
   - Entire Graph: the code locations each matched decision affects
2. answer: a Groq model may phrase the answer, but only from those facts, citing their ids; an
   answer citing anything else is discarded for the plain fact list. No matching decision with
   a recorded reason -> "no recorded reason". History is never invented.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

STOP = set("""a an the is are was were be been why did do does we our us i you it its this that
these those to of for in on at by with from and or not no what which who how when where use
used using pick picked choose chose chosen decide decided decision instead over than""".split())
NO_REASON = "no recorded reason"


def words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    toks = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*", (text or "").lower())
    return [t.strip("._/-") for t in toks if t not in STOP and len(t.strip("._/-")) >= 2]


def _score(qwords: list[str], text: str) -> int:
    low = (text or "").lower()
    return sum(1 for w in qwords if re.search(rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(w)}", low))


class Facts:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items: list[dict] = []

    def add(self, text: str, source: str, kind: str) -> str:
        fid = f"F{len(self.items) + 1}"
        self.items.append({"id": fid, "text": text, "source": source, "kind": kind})
        return fid

    def ids(self) -> set[str]:
        return {f["id"] for f in self.items}


def match_decisions(graph, question: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Decisions the question is about (label words weigh most), best first."""
    from notbydefault.records import why_text
    q = words(question)
    scored = []
    for d in graph.nodes("decision"):
        label_hits = _score(q, d["label"]) + _score(q, d["label"].split("/")[-1])
        other = _score(q, f"{d['data'].get('category')} {d['data'].get('kind')} {why_text(d)}")
        alts = sum(_score(q, a["label"]) for a in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("rejects",)))
        score = 3 * label_hits + other + 2 * alts
        if label_hits or alts:
            scored.append((score, d["id"], d))
    return [d for _s, _i, d in sorted(scored, key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1]))]


def graph_facts(graph, decisions: list[dict], facts: Facts) -> dict[int, bool]:
    """Facts per decision; returns {decision id: has a recorded reason}."""
    from notbydefault.affected import describe
    from notbydefault.graph import affected_entries
    reasons = {}
    for d in decisions:
        data = d["data"]
        src = f"decision #{d['id']}" + (f", {data['decision_record']}" if data.get("decision_record") else "")
        recorded = data.get("verdict_summary") or data.get("stale_reason") or data.get("review_reason")
        reasons[d["id"]] = bool(recorded)
        status = data.get("status")
        if data.get("verdict_summary"):
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` ({status}): fit-test verdict: "
                      f"{data['verdict_summary']}", src, "reason")
        if status == "stale":
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` is STALE: {data.get('stale_reason')}",
                      src + (f", requirement #{data['stale_cause']}" if data.get("stale_cause") else ""),
                      "reason")
        if status == "needs_review":
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` needs review: {data.get('review_reason')}",
                      src + (f", requirement #{data['review_cause']}" if data.get("review_cause") else ""),
                      "reason")
        if not recorded:
            how = f" ({data['evidence']})" if data.get("evidence") else ""
            facts.add(f"Decision #{d['id']} `{d['label']}` was picked by a coding agent's "
                      f"{data.get('tool_name') or 'tool'} call{how}; {NO_REASON} beyond that",
                      src + (f", session {d['session_id']}" if d.get("session_id") else ""),
                      "no_reason")
        for a in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("rejects",)):
            facts.add(f"Rejected alternative `{a['label']}`: {a['data'].get('reason') or NO_REASON}",
                      f"alternative #{a['id']}", "alternative")
        for e in graph.neighbors(d["id"], ("supported_by",)):
            link = e["data"].get("path") or e["data"].get("url")
            facts.add(f"Evidence: {e['label']}", f"evidence #{e['id']}" + (f", {link}" if link else ""),
                      "evidence")
        code = [e for e in affected_entries(d) if e.get("symbol")][:6] or affected_entries(d)[:3]
        if code:
            facts.add(f"Code using `{d['label']}`: " + "; ".join(f"{describe(e)} ({e.get('via')})"
                                                                for e in code),
                      f"{data.get('affected_source') or 'touched files'}: "
                      + ", ".join(f"{e['path']}:{e['line']}" if e.get("line") else e["path"]
                                  for e in code), "code")
    return reasons


def history_facts(project: Path, question: str, decisions: list[dict], facts: Facts,
                  entire, tracer=None) -> str:
    """Entire search hits, or local checkpoints + git log; returns how history was searched."""
    from notbydefault.briefing import load_cache
    from notbydefault.entire import git
    q = words(question) + [w for d in decisions[:2] for w in words(d["label"])]
    hits = entire.search(question, project, limit=5)
    if hits is not None:
        for h in hits:
            if h.get("id"):
                facts.add(f"Entire {h.get('type', 'result')}: {h.get('title') or h.get('snippet')}",
                          f"entire {h.get('type', 'result')} {h['id']}", "history")
        return "entire search"
    why = entire.last_error()
    if tracer is not None:
        tracer.event("search_fallback", "recovery",
                     f"`entire search` unavailable ({why}); searching local checkpoints and git log")
    cps = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if cps is None:
        cps = [{"checkpoint_id": c["id"], "message": c.get("message"), "session_ids": c.get("sessions")}
               for c in load_cache(project).get("checkpoints") or []]
    for c in cps:
        if c.get("checkpoint_id") and _score(q, c.get("message", "")):
            sess = (c.get("session_ids") or [c.get("session_id")])[0]
            facts.add(f"Checkpoint: {c.get('message')}",
                      f"checkpoint {c['checkpoint_id']}" + (f", session {sess}" if sess else ""),
                      "history")
    log = git(["log", "-n", "300", "--format=%H%x09%s", "--", "."], project) or ""
    for line in log.splitlines():
        sha, _, subject = line.partition("\t")
        if subject and _score(q, subject) >= max(1, min(2, len(q))):
            facts.add(f"Commit: {subject}", f"commit {sha}", "history")
    return f"local checkpoints and git log (entire search unavailable: {why})"

ANSWER_SYSTEM = ("You answer a developer's question about why a technical decision was made, "
                 "using ONLY the numbered facts given. Never add history, reasons or numbers "
                 "that are not in the facts. Answer with one JSON object only.")
ANSWER_PROMPT = """Question: {question}

Facts (each has an id and a source):
{facts}

Write a short answer (at most 5 sentences). After every claim put the id(s) of the fact(s) it
comes from in square brackets, e.g. [F2]. If the facts don't contain the reason, say there is
no recorded reason. Return {{"answer": "<text with [F#] citations>", "cited": ["F1", ...]}}"""


def llm_answer(caller, model: str, question: str, facts: Facts) -> str | None:
    """A phrased answer whose citations all exist, or None (then the facts are shown as-is)."""
    import json
    from notbydefault.llm import parse_json
    listing = "\n".join(f"{f['id']}: {f['text']} (source: {f['source']})" for f in facts.items)
    reply = caller.chat(model, [{"role": "system", "content": ANSWER_SYSTEM},
                                {"role": "user", "content": ANSWER_PROMPT.format(
                                    question=question, facts=listing[:12000])}],
                        span="notbydefault.why_answer", role="why", max_tokens=1500,
                        json_mode=True, focus_area="execution")
    data = parse_json(reply.text)
    text = str(data.get("answer") or "").strip()
    cited = set(re.findall(r"\bF\d+\b", text))
    if not text or not cited or not cited <= facts.ids():
        return None
    return text


def render(question: str, facts: Facts, answer: str, searched: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f"Q: {question}", "", answer, "", "Sources:"]
    lines += [f"  [{f['id']}] {f['text']}\n        ({f['source']})" for f in facts.items]
    lines += ["", f"History searched with: {searched}"]
    return lines


def plain_answer(facts: Facts, reasons: dict[int, bool]) -> str:
    """The deterministic answer: recorded reasons first, else say there is none."""
    picked = [f for f in facts.items if f["kind"] in ("reason", "alternative", "no_reason")]
    if not any(reasons.values()):
        head = f"There is {NO_REASON} for this decision."
        return head + ("" if not picked else " What is recorded: " +
                       " ".join(f"{f['text']} [{f['id']}]." for f in picked[:4]))
    return " ".join(f"{f['text']} [{f['id']}]." for f in picked[:5])


def why(project: Path, question: str, client=None, entire=None, tracer=None, out=print,
        use_llm: bool = True) -> int:
    from notbydefault.entire import Entire
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import make_tracer
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph, db_path
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}; {NO_REASON}.")
        return 1
    entire = entire or Entire()
    tracer = tracer or make_tracer()
    facts = Facts()
    with tracer.root("notbydefault.why", {"notbydefault.question": question}):
        with tracer.step("plan", "planning",
                         reason="answer only from recorded facts: graph, decision records, "
                                "Entire history and Entire Graph code locations"):
            pass
        with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
            with tracer.step("graph_lookup", "state", reason="decisions the question is about"):
                decisions = match_decisions(g, question)[:3]
                reasons = graph_facts(g, decisions, facts)
                tracer.event("decisions_matched", "state",
                             f"{len(decisions)} decision(s): {[d['id'] for d in decisions]}")
        with tracer.step("history_lookup", "context",
                         reason="past sessions, checkpoints and commits about it (Entire)"):
            searched = history_facts(project, question, decisions, facts, entire, tracer)
        if not decisions and not facts.items:
            out(f"Q: {question}\n\nThere is {NO_REASON}: no decision in the Decision Graph, "
                f"checkpoint or commit matches this question (searched: {searched}).")
            tracer.flush()
            return 0
        answer = plain_answer(facts, reasons) if decisions else (
            f"There is {NO_REASON} in the Decision Graph; related history: "
            + " ".join(f"{f['text']} [{f['id']}]." for f in facts.items[:4]))
        if use_llm and decisions and any(reasons.values()):
            with tracer.step("answer", "execution",
                             reason="phrase the answer from the facts, citing their ids"):
                try:
                    if client is None:
                        from notbydefault.env import load_env
                        from notbydefault.fit.providers import ProviderSet, load_catalog
                        load_env()
                        client = ProviderSet(load_catalog(project),
                                             cache_dir=project / ".notbydefault" / "cache")
                    from notbydefault.fit.evaluate import Caller, SpendGuard
                    from notbydefault.fit.providers import role_model
                    caller = Caller(client, SpendGuard(0.05), tracer)
                    phrased = llm_answer(caller, role_model(client.catalog, "why"), question, facts)
                except Exception as e:
                    phrased = None
                    tracer.event("answer_fallback", "recovery",
                                 f"model answer unavailable ({e}); showing the recorded facts")
            with tracer.step("verify_citations", "verification",
                             reason="every claim must cite a retrieved fact"):
                if phrased:
                    answer = phrased
                else:
                    tracer.event("citations_rejected", "recovery",
                                 "the model's answer cited nothing or unknown ids; using the "
                                 "plain fact list instead")
        for line in render(question, facts, answer, searched):
            out(line)
    tracer.flush()
    return 0

"""Test scout: edge cases the agent discussed while touching a decision's code but never tested.

  1. affected code of the decision (Entire Graph analysis stored on the node)
  2. checkpoints whose sessions touched those files (`entire checkpoint list` + `explain --json`)
  3. their transcripts (`entire checkpoint explain <id> --transcript`): user/assistant text that
     mentions the files, functions or edge-case words
  4. a Groq model extracts edge cases from those excerpts, quoting its evidence; a case whose
     quote isn't in the transcripts, or that the existing test inputs already cover, is dropped
  5. the rest are saved as "suggested" verifier cases in .notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl;
     nothing runs them until someone promotes them into the samples file
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

EDGE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(edge case|empty|blank|unicode|emoji|timezone|time zone|leap|null|"
                        r"none|missing|malformed|invalid|too long|large|huge|duplicate|"
                        r"what if|what about|fails?|crash|error|retry|timeout|rate limit|"
                        r"multilingual|language|cancel+ed|ambiguous|relative date|not tested|"
                        r"untested|corner case)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 9000
MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 5

SCOUT_SYSTEM = ("You extract edge cases from a coding agent's conversation that were discussed but "
                "may not be tested. Answer with one JSON object only.")
SCOUT_PROMPT = """Feature under test: {feature}
Code: {code}

Existing test inputs (truncated):
{tests}

Conversation excerpts (from Entire checkpoints):
{excerpts}

List edge cases for this feature that the conversation raises. For each, quote the exact words
from the excerpts that raise it (copy them verbatim, 3 to 20 words), and say whether the existing
test inputs already cover it. Return
{{"cases": [{{"input": "<a concrete test input for the feature>", "why": "<one line>",
             "evidence": "<verbatim quote>", "already_tested": true or false}}]}}"""


def _text(message) -> str:
    content = (message or {}).get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content
                         if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text")
    return ""


def excerpts(transcript: list[dict], needles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """User/assistant text that mentions the code or an edge-case word."""
    out = []
    for row in transcript:
        if row.get("type") not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        text = _text(row.get("message")).strip()
        if not text or text.startswith("<"):
            continue
        if any(n and n.lower() in text.lower() for n in needles) and EDGE_WORDS.search(text):
            out.append(f"[{row['type']}] " + " ".join(text.split())[:1200])
    return out


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", s.lower()).split())


def existing_inputs(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> list[str]:
    from notbydefault.fit import failures as failures_mod
    from notbydefault.fit import samples as samples_mod
    samples = samples_mod.load(project, decision_id) or []
    return [s["user_message"] for s in samples] + failures_mod.inputs(project, decision_id)


def suggested_path(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> Path:
    return Path(project) / ".notbydefault" / "suggested" / f"{decision_id}.jsonl"

"""Test scout: edge cases the agent discussed while touching a decision's code but never tested.

  1. affected code of the decision (Entire Graph analysis stored on the node)
  2. checkpoints whose sessions touched those files (`entire checkpoint list` + `explain --json`)
  3. their transcripts (`entire checkpoint explain <id> --transcript`): user/assistant text that
     mentions the files, functions or edge-case words
  4. a Groq model extracts edge cases from those excerpts, quoting its evidence; a case whose
     quote isn't in the transcripts, or that the existing test inputs already cover, is dropped
  5. the rest are saved as "suggested" verifier cases in .notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl;
     nothing runs them until someone promotes them into the samples file
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

EDGE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(edge case|empty|blank|unicode|emoji|timezone|time zone|leap|null|"
                        r"none|missing|malformed|invalid|too long|large|huge|duplicate|"
                        r"what if|what about|fails?|crash|error|retry|timeout|rate limit|"
                        r"multilingual|language|cancel+ed|ambiguous|relative date|not tested|"
                        r"untested|corner case)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 9000
MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 5

SCOUT_SYSTEM = ("You extract edge cases from a coding agent's conversation that were discussed but "
                "may not be tested. Answer with one JSON object only.")
SCOUT_PROMPT = """Feature under test: {feature}
Code: {code}

Existing test inputs (truncated):
{tests}

Conversation excerpts (from Entire checkpoints):
{excerpts}

List edge cases for this feature that the conversation raises. For each, quote the exact words
from the excerpts that raise it (copy them verbatim, 3 to 20 words), and say whether the existing
test inputs already cover it. Return
{{"cases": [{{"input": "<a concrete test input for the feature>", "why": "<one line>",
             "evidence": "<verbatim quote>", "already_tested": true or false}}]}}"""


def _text(message) -> str:
    content = (message or {}).get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content
                         if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text")
    return ""


def excerpts(transcript: list[dict], needles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """User/assistant text that mentions the code or an edge-case word."""
    out = []
    for row in transcript:
        if row.get("type") not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        text = _text(row.get("message")).strip()
        if not text or text.startswith("<"):
            continue
        if any(n and n.lower() in text.lower() for n in needles) and EDGE_WORDS.search(text):
            out.append(f"[{row['type']}] " + " ".join(text.split())[:1200])
    return out


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", s.lower()).split())


def existing_inputs(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> list[str]:
    from notbydefault.fit import failures as failures_mod
    from notbydefault.fit import samples as samples_mod
    samples = samples_mod.load(project, decision_id) or []
    return [s["user_message"] for s in samples] + failures_mod.inputs(project, decision_id)


def suggested_path(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> Path:
    return Path(project) / ".notbydefault" / "suggested" / f"{decision_id}.jsonl"


def _prefix(project: Path) -> str:
    from notbydefault.entire import repo_root
    root = repo_root(project)
    if root is None or root == project:
        return ""
    try:
        return project.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/"
    except ValueError:
        return ""


def find_checkpoints(project: Path, entire, files: list[str], tracer) -> list[tuple] | None:
    """[(checkpoint id, list row, touched affected files)], or None when unavailable."""
    listed = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if listed is None:
        tracer.event("checkpoints_unavailable", "recovery",

    {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "name": "Edit"}]}},
    {"type": "user", "message": {"content": "unrelated: rename the README"}},
])

        ("checkpoint", "list"): listing,

        ("checkpoint", "explain", "01OTHER", "--json"): json.dumps({"files_touched": ["README.md"]}),
        ("checkpoint", "explain", "01TOUCH", "--transcript"): transcript,
    })


@pytest.fixture
def project(tmp_path):
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        did = g.add_node("decision", "openai/gpt-oss-120b", {
            "kind": "model", "category": "ai-model", "status": "reviewed", "file": "app.py",
            "files": ["app.py"], "affected_source": "entire-graph", "affected_files": ["app.py"],

                               "via": "uses literal", "depth": 0}]})
    return tmp_path, did

    out, t = [], Tracer()

    tr = transport or FakeTransport()

    return code, "\n".join(out), t, tr, r

    p, did = project
    code, text, t, tr, r = run(p, did)

def test_rerun_does_not_duplicate_suggestions(project):
    p, did = project
    run(p, did)
    run(p, did)
    assert len(suggested_path(p, did).read_text().splitlines()) == 1

    p, did = project
    listing = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01OTHER", "session_id": "sess-b"}])

    assert code == 0 and "No checkpoints available" in text and tr.calls == []
    assert any(e["name"] == "checkpoints_unavailable" for e in t.journal)

"""`notbydefault checkpoints <id>`: the Entire checkpoint of the commit that added a record.

  1. the decision's record path (decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md)
  2. `git log --diff-filter=A` -> the full SHA of the commit that added it
  3. its checkpoint: the commit's `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, else
     `entire checkpoint explain --commit <sha> --json`
  4. the matching rows of `entire checkpoint list --json`, and the link
     https://entire.io/gh/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<FULL_SHA>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from notbydefault.entire import Entire, commit_link, git, repo_slug


def record_commit(project: Path, record: str) -> str | None:
    """Full SHA of the commit that added `record` (oldest add wins), or None."""
    out = git(["log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "--", record], project)
    shas = (out or "").split()
    return shas[-1] if shas else None


def checkpoint_of(project: Path, sha: str, entire: Entire) -> str | None:
    body = git(["log", "-1", "--format=%B", sha], project) or ""
    m = re.search(r"^Entire-Checkpoint:\s*(\S+)", body, re.M)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)
    info = entire.checkpoint_explain(sha, project, commit=True)
    return (info or {}).get("checkpoint_id")


def show(project: Path, decision_id: int, entire: Entire | None = None, out=print) -> int:
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph, db_path
    from notbydefault.records import existing_path
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}.")
        return 1
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        d = g.get_node(decision_id)
    if not d or d["type"] != "decision":
        out(f"No decision #{decision_id}")
        return 1
    path = existing_path(project, d)
    if path is None:
        out(f"Decision #{decision_id} has no decision record yet; run "
            f"`python -m notbydefault records {decision_id}` and commit it.")
        return 1
    rel = path.relative_to(project).as_posix()
    entire = entire or Entire()
    slug = repo_slug(project)
    sha = record_commit(project, rel)
    out(f"Decision #{decision_id} {d['label']}: record {rel}")
    if sha is None:
        out("  not committed yet: commit it, then run this again. Its checkpoint link will be "
            f"https://entire.io/gh/{slug or '<owner>/<repo>'}/commit/<FULL_SHA>")
        return 0
    out(f"  added in commit {sha}")
    cid = checkpoint_of(project, sha, entire)
    out(f"  checkpoint: {cid or 'none linked (' + (entire.last_error() or 'no Entire-Checkpoint trailer') + ')'}")
    rows = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if rows is None:
        out(f"  `entire checkpoint list` unavailable: {entire.last_error()}")
    else:
        mine = [r for r in rows if cid and r.get("checkpoint_id") == cid]
        out("  entire checkpoint list:" + ("" if mine else " (no matching row)"))
        for r in mine:
            out(f"    {r.get('checkpoint_id')}  {r.get('date', '')}  {r.get('agent', '')}  "
                f"\"{r.get('message', '')}\"  sessions: {', '.join(r.get('session_ids') or [r.get('session_id') or '-'])}")
    if slug:
        out(f"  link: {commit_link(slug, sha)}")
    else:
        out("  link: (origin is not a GitHub remote; format is "
            "https://entire.io/gh/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<FULL_SHA>)")
    return 0

"""Milestone 4 part 7: checkpoint of the commit that added a decision record."""
import json
import subprocess

from conftest import FakeEntireRunner
from notbydefault.checkpoints import show
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.records import write_record


def git(path, *args):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.email=t@t", "-c", "user.name=t", *args], cwd=path,
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def setup(tmp_path, trailer=True):
    git(tmp_path, "init", "-q")
    git(tmp_path, "remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/Mischa0099/notbydefault.git")
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        did = g.add_node("decision", "MongoDB", {"kind": "service", "category": "database",
                                                 "status": "unreviewed"})
        write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "detected")
    git(tmp_path, "add", "decisions")
    msg = "Add decision record" + ("\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: 01CHECKPOINTID" if trailer else "")
    git(tmp_path, "commit", "-q", "-m", msg)
    sha = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=tmp_path, capture_output=True,
                         text=True).stdout.strip()
    return did, sha


LIST = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01CHECKPOINTID", "session_id": "sess-1", "agent": "Claude Code",
                    "date": "2026-10-11T01:03:29+05:30", "message": "Add decision record",
                    "session_ids": ["sess-1"]},
                   {"checkpoint_id": "01OTHER", "message": "x"}])


def test_shows_checkpoint_row_and_full_sha_link(tmp_path):
    did, sha = setup(tmp_path)
    out = []
    show(tmp_path, did, Entire(exe="entire", runner=FakeEntireRunner({("checkpoint", "list"): LIST})),
         out.append)
    text = "\n".join(out)
    assert f"added in commit {sha}" in text and "checkpoint: 01CHECKPOINTID" in text
    assert "01CHECKPOINTID  2026-10-11T01:03:29+05:30  Claude Code" in text and "01OTHER" not in text
    assert f"https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/{sha}" in text
    assert len(sha) == 40


def test_falls_back_to_explain_commit_without_trailer(tmp_path):
    did, sha = setup(tmp_path, trailer=False)
    out = []
    runner = FakeEntireRunner({("checkpoint", "list"): LIST,

cat >> README.md <<'MDEOF'

## Entire integration

NotByDefault reads Entire for code and history, and writes decision records that Entire
checkpoints with your commits. Every Entire call degrades gracefully: when the CLI, a plugin,
login or a mirrored repo is missing, the command falls back (and says so) instead of failing.

| command | what it does | Entire used |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m notbydefault affected [id] --project P` | every file and function using a decision's model/service, stored as `code` nodes with `affects` edges | `entire graph symbols` / `edges` (falls back to the files the agent touched) |
| `python -m notbydefault require P "<requirement>"` | two lists: **stale** (a documented fact conflicts) and **needs review** (depends on deployment, or only the model's judgement) | Graph for the affected code |
| `python -m notbydefault records [id] --project P` | writes/updates `decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md` (why, evidence, rejected alternatives, caveats, affected code, history); `check`, `require` and accepted pivots do this automatically | Brain, if `entire-brain` is installed |
| `python -m notbydefault why "<question>" --project P [--llm]` | answers only from recorded facts, each cited (decision record, evidence, checkpoint/session/commit, code location); says "no recorded reason" otherwise | `entire search`, else `entire checkpoint list` + `git log`; Graph |
| `python -m notbydefault scout <id> --project P` | edge cases the agent discussed in sessions that touched the code, saved as *suggested* cases in `.notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl` | `entire checkpoint list` / `explain --transcript` |
| `python -m notbydefault checkpoints <id> --project P` | the `entire checkpoint list` row and link for the commit that added the decision's record | `entire checkpoint explain --commit` |

The PreToolUse hook adds a briefing of at most 4 lines (related past decisions, rejected
alternatives, history, reusable code, each with a source id). It reads only the graph and
`.notbydefault/entire_cache.json`, then refreshes that cache in a detached process; `check`
shows the full briefing after a live refresh.

### Checkpoint links

A decision record lands in the Entire checkpoint of the commit that adds it. Its page is

    https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/<FULL_SHA>

where `<FULL_SHA>` is the full 40-character commit SHA (`git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H --
decisions/<record>.md`, or `python -m notbydefault checkpoints <id>`). For example, the commit
that added `demo-app/decisions/0001-ai-model-openai-gpt-oss-120b.md` (checkpoint
`01M4KMWR0G2BHVEMNG9MMHHP6G`):
https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/35c61621951e0317126ed33c88fdd99954608157

### Entire Brain

Not in the Entire plugin index as of entire 0.11.4 (`entire plugin search brain` finds nothing).
If you have it, install it with `entire plugin install <its repository URL or a local
entire-brain executable>`, then run `python -m notbydefault records --project P`. NotByDefault
only calls a Brain subcommand that the installed plugin's own `--help` documents.
MDEOF

- **Affected code:** for `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, the tool call only touched `app.py`. Entire Graph found `summarize_notes`, `extract_action_items` in `actions.py`, and their caller `Handler.do_POST`. For MongoDB it found `next_note_id`, `Handler.do_GET`, `Handler.do_POST` and `requirements.txt`.

- **Briefing:** the real hook took 185 ms and showed 4 lines, each with a source id: a past decision, a rejected alternative, reusable code (`actions.py:28 extract_action_items` already calls `openai.OpenAI`), and a second past decision. It showed no history line because a fresh copy has no checkpoints. Entire search was unavailable because the repo isn't mirrored, and it fell back to local checkpoints and git log as designed.

- **Scout:** run read-only against the real checkpoint `01M4KMWR0G2BHVEMNG9MMHHP6G`, it proposed 10 edge cases, and every quoted piece of evidence was found in the transcript.

- **Entire Brain** isn't installed and isn't in the plugin index, and its commands aren't in Entire's docs. Records skip Brain and say how to install it; once installed, the code only uses a save command that the plugin's own `--help` documents.

- **Home-folder repo:** `C:\Users\misch` is itself a git repository. Projects that aren't their own repo skip the graph lookup and fall back to the files the agent touched, so that Entire Graph doesn't index your whole home folder.

- affected: find_affected_code now uses Entire Graph (symbols + CALLS/IMPORTS edges) to find

  clients and callers up to 2 hops. Results are stored as code nodes with affects edges. Falls
  back to the touched files when entire-graph, git or the plugin is unavailable, and refuses to
  index a home-directory repo. New `affected` command.

  new service_facts.yaml). Deployment-dependent services (e.g. MongoDB) and model-only
  judgements become "needs review". The two lists are reported separately with reason,
  basis and source.
- records: every verdict (check, blocked check, require, accepted pivot) writes or updates
  decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md with a generated summary block (why, evidence, rejected
  alternatives, caveats, affected code, history). Each decision keeps one record, rewritten in
  place. Records are offered to Entire Brain only through a subcommand its own --help
  documents; when Brain isn't installed, the record is skipped for Brain with install
  instructions. New `records` command.
- briefing: the PreToolUse hook adds at most 4 cited lines (past decisions, rejected
  alternatives, checkpoint/commit history, reusable code), reading only the graph and
  .notbydefault/entire_cache.json. It refreshes the cache detached. `check` shows the full
  briefing after a live refresh.
- why: answers from cited facts (decision records, evidence, Entire search or local
  checkpoints + git log, Graph code locations) and says "no recorded reason" otherwise.
  Status notes are never presented as reasons. Model phrasing is opt-in (--llm), with
  citation checks.
- scout: reads transcripts of checkpoints that touched the affected code, extracts edge
  cases with Groq, drops any case whose quote isn't in the transcript or that is already

- checkpoints: shows the `entire checkpoint list` row and the entire.io commit link for the

- Hook steps and new commands journal focus_area-tagged steps and recovery events for

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
